key_findings: Chemogenetic activation of rACC GABAergic neurons or agonism of rACC GABAA/GABAB receptors blocked pain-memory hyperpathia and anxiety-like behavior in carrageenan cross-injection rats.
Inhibiting rACC GABAergic neurons or antagonizing rACC GABAA/GABAB receptors reversed the analgesic and anxiolytic effects of ST36 electroacupuncture.
